decisions.reason: Core polymer concrete drain housing remains essential to the drainage system family and has established technology, though reduced web presence adds moderate risk.
Flagship designer shower drainage product is strongly aligned with the firm's strategic direction and customer focus.
Shower element with integrated slope supports floor-level shower systems, but its niche installation requirements create moderate uncertainty.
Backflow-protected basement floor drain addresses a specific safety need and has dedicated launch history, though it is somewhat outside the core bathroom focus.
Air-admittance valve is a peripheral accessory with limited fit to the core drainage portfolio, so we drop it to release resources for more strategic products.
